title: Tamil Nadu Politics – Morning Brief – 31 October 2026
headline: Seeman hints at accepting the support of DMK and AIADMK in Ambasamudram byelection

sections.big_picture: Key developments in this 12-hour briefing include: Seeman hints at accepting the support of DMK and AIADMK in Ambasamudram byelection; Sollathigaram | "CM விஜயை முதலில் நாங்கள் ஒரு பொருட்டாவே மதிக்கல.." - மதிமுக அந்திரிதாஸ்; Plea in Madras High Court seeks probe into nationality of Cockroach Janata Party co-convenor Saurav Das; Stalin demands apology from T.N. CM Vijay for MIDS professor’s detention; TVK denies ‘political vendetta’ claim.
